Title: Verify the Gradle build resolves and executes successfully with the new configuration
Preconditions: Gradle is installed on the system. The project is checked out with the new build.gradle and settings.gradle files.
Steps:
1. Navigate to the project root directory. 2. Run the command: `./gradlew build`. 3. Observe the build output for errors or warnings.

Test Data: New build.gradle with plugins: java, dependencies: JUnit 5.9.1, and test configuration: useJUnitPlatform()
Expected Result: The build completes successfully without errors, and all dependencies are resolved from Maven Central.

Title: Verify the Gradle wrapper downloads and uses the correct Gradle version (8.0-bin)
Preconditions: The project is checked out with the new gradle-wrapper.properties file. No existing Gradle wrapper distribution is cached.
Steps:
1. Navigate to the project root directory. 2. Run the command: `./gradlew wrapper --version`. 3. Observe the output for the Gradle version.

Test Data: New gradle-wrapper.properties with distributionUrl=https://services.gradle.org/distributions/gradle-8.0-bin.zip
Expected Result: The Gradle wrapper downloads version 8.0-bin and reports this version in the output.

Title: Verify JUnit 5 tests run successfully with the new test configuration
Preconditions: The project is built successfully. A sample JUnit 5 test class exists in the project (e.g., CalculatorTest).
Steps:
1. Navigate to the project root directory. 2. Run the command: `./gradlew test`. 3. Observe the test output for failures or errors.

Test Data: New build.gradle with testImplementation 'org.junit.jupiter:junit-jupiter' and test { useJUnitPlatform() }
Expected Result: All JUnit 5 tests execute successfully, and the test report shows no failures.

Title: Verify the IDE project settings (language level and JDK) are compatible with the project
Preconditions: The project is opened in an IDE (e.g., IntelliJ IDEA) with the new .idea/misc.xml file.
Steps:

Expected Result: The IDE correctly identifies the project as a Gradle project, and the root module is linked without errors.

Title: Verify the IDE recognizes the Git repository configuration
Preconditions: The project is opened in an IDE (e.g., IntelliJ IDEA) with the new .idea/vcs.xml file. The project is in a Git repository.
